column1: # Constants that exist once per language and must never drift apart. Each side asserts
# its own definition against this file, so changing one without the other fails rather
# than producing two implementations that quietly disagree about the wire.
# Values are decimal so both readers stay trivial.
# The N3 operation and signed-domain tags. Frozen here before anything is written
# against them, because this is the last point at which changing one is cheap.
